xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5293: Workflow redesign F: one left column replaces the sidebar and Command Deck column; Awareness becomes the Activity feed

plan.title: Workflow redesign F: one left column replaces the sidebar and Command Deck column; Awareness becomes the Activity feed
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Three always-open side columns (nav Sidebar 256 px, the Command Deck column 320 px, the Awareness rail 300 px) leave the chat about 750 px wide at 1920 px, and the deck lists exist only on the command-deck route.
narratives.Proposal: Extract the Command Deck list state and handlers into route-independent modules under components/frame/deck/ with an App-level openInDeck door (no behavior change), build one left column (switcher, nav, New conversation, Conversations, Issues, Workspaces, footer) against them, swap the frame in one item (full-width top bar with brand, Sidebar and deck column removed), and move the Awareness feed to a Feed tab on /activity while removing the rail and the History toggle.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Project Home changes (child G), including moving the project CI/identity/deploy chips to Project Home
- Inverting successor chains to newest-first in the conversation tree
- Adding a Projects group to the command palette
- Changing PipelineView, God View, Board, Flywheel or Order Book pages
- Mobile layout beyond the left-column drawer below 900 px; the /m phone shell
- Ledger theme parity beyond not breaking
- Any new polling loop or refetchInterval
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

metadata.sizeJustification: Parent PRD D-13 requires the child that removes the Command Deck column to move its lists in the same PR so the dashboard stays usable after the Flywheel reloads it; the extraction, section, swap and Awareness items are therefore one deliverable. The surface is mostly new files under components/frame/ plus docs; each item is independently reviewable and gated by its own tests.

autoDecisions.summary: Left column lists the selected project on every route; row clicks open the pane then switch to the deck via openInDeck
autoDecisions.rationale: Mockup shows one persistent frame column; App selectedProjectKey already survives route changes (F-D3).

autoDecisions.summary: Deck selection moves to useCommandDeckSelection; deep-link and URL-sync effects stay in CommandDeck
autoDecisions.rationale: Only one of the two consumers is mounted per route; keeping the effects in place preserves mount semantics (F-D1).

autoDecisions.summary: Session-tree subscription, container poll and N shortcut have one owner in the frame (DeckDataHost / New conversation button)
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids duplicate WS subscriptions and double shortcut registration (F-D4).

autoDecisions.summary: Project switcher menu lists every project (owner groups kept) instead of "All N projects… (Ctrl K)"
autoDecisions.rationale: The command palette has no Projects group; adding one is outside F (F-D7).

autoDecisions.summary: Project marks use neutral initials, no per-project color
autoDecisions.rationale: Style guide forbids hex and decorative color (F-D7).

autoDecisions.summary: Workspaces section is project-scoped; the Flat/Group toggle is dropped
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent §6.6 scopes the section to the project; other workspaces stay reachable via Ctrl K and the switcher (F-D9).

autoDecisions.summary: Conversations Active/All via a new ConversationList scope prop; Favorites tab and sort stay inside the list
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps WorkspaceView unchanged and loses no control (F-D13).

autoDecisions.summary: Compact issue rows; collapsed-row badges move unchanged into the expanded body
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the mockup while keeping every badge reachable (F-D16).

autoDecisions.summary: Feed tab reuses SessionFeedSidebar with its scope switcher, keeping DecisionsPanel mounted
autoDecisions.rationale: Parent §7 says the same feed and scopes; the Needs-you menu cannot host DecisionsPanel inline cards (F-D21).

autoDecisions.summary: Theme toggle and Search are not repeated in the footer; version moves to the footer and the brand to the top bar
autoDecisions.rationale: E already put theme and search in the top bar; parent §6.6 puts version in the footer; E-D4 hands the brand to F (F-D14, F-D19).

autoDecisions.summary: Drag-to-project on conversation rows is removed
autoDecisions.rationale: Its only drop target was Sidebar.tsx; parent D-14 names Move ▸ as the replacement (F-D20).
PipelineView already renders phase and project filters and reads the URL params (F-D11).

autoDecisions.summary: Jump-to-terminal is pinned by a test plus a waiting-time sub-line, no new control
autoDecisions.rationale: needsYou.ts openSubject already routes non-answerable conversation permissions to the terminal (F-D23).

autoDecisions.summary: Dead showTasks TasksDialog branch in CommandDeck is deleted
autoDecisions.rationale: showTasks is never set true; App TasksViewerHost already serves Tasks (F-D6).

autoDecisions.summary: Project query key unified to ["command-deck-projects"], epoch replaced by invalidateQueries
autoDecisions.rationale: Removes the duplicate cache entry the Sidebar and deck kept (F-D5).

autoDecisions.summary: Update existing features/mission-control.mdx instead of adding a new docs page
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids docs.json nav changes; that page already documents the deck.
